proves.claim: At the board-release-codes engine the stale sweep's idle and lapsed-claim releases carry a closed code (SEAT_GONE, BUILDER_SILENT, LEASE_LAPSED) with the prose reason unchanged.

store.stale-apply.claim-release-codes.why: Board-written releases are the bulk of all releases; a closed code instead of OTHER lets the board count why claims return.

proves.claim: Below the board-release-codes engine the same stale-sweep releases still carry OTHER, so older boards replay unchanged.

store.stale-apply.claim-release-codes-be.why: A board below the engine must replay its history exactly as before.
